name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.0-dev.37 (17 Nov): performance batch (NLOS fire checked once per frame, one merged overkill hook, hook health log every 60 s, no whole-scene searches in battle, every deck model preloaded at match start, infantry body swaps spread over frames; FAModels 0.3.34, FA Music 1.5.3), MD-22 on the F-35A body with afterburners, China spec names in English and Chinese, SF night card portraits, 110 new Blood Wolves and Godswords callouts. Includes 0.9.0-dev.36. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.45.
